findings.text: Acceptance 4: reopening the same conversation from Wiki leaves channels hidden. In bootApp, go('#/c/general'), go('#/wiki'), go('#/c/general') produced {view:'chat',place:'wiki',channels:false}; the base produces home/true. lastConversation suppresses this explicit navigation. Distinguish user navigation from address cleanup rather than deduplicating solely by conversation.

Acceptance 3: returning from Search to Wiki can leave its rail button inactive. In bootApp with rendered rail attributes, openWikiPage('nowosci'); state.view='search'; views.render(); await openWikiPage('nowosci') produced {view:'wiki',place:'wiki',on:false,aria:null}; the base produces on:true and aria:'page'. Repaint the rail when the view changes even if the selected place is unchanged.

Acceptance 3/4: delayed conversation cleanup can hide a newer wiki page's tree. In bootApp, hold messages, start openConversation(1,9999), await openWikiPage('nowosci'), then release messages: {view:'wiki',place:'wiki'} becomes {view:'wiki',place:'home',wikiTree:false}; the base retains Wiki. The late syncRoute cleanup is treated as navigation after lastConversation resets. Guard stale cleanup and exclude address maintenance from navigation events.

Background wiki refreshes now override an explicit sidebar choice. In bootApp, openWikiPage('nowosci'), select Home, then dispatch the captured SSE wiki callback with {slug:'nowosci'}: place changes home→wiki; the base preserves home. SSE refresh calls openWikiPage, whose syncRoute now announces user navigation. Separate background refreshes from explicit page-opening actions so another actor's edit cannot switch the reader's sidebar.

Acceptance 8: three T38-r1 tests were removed without an authorizing decision. Reproduction: git diff -U0 b01c47f e7bc363 -- test/ui-t38-wiki-place.test.ts shows three deleted -test("T38-r1: ...") declarations; the report confirms removal. The in-range decisions do not authorize these deletions. Preserve/adapt the existing tests and their behavioral coverage, or obtain the required decision before removing them.
